name: Giuseppina Fiorillo

birth.place: San Mango d'Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy

bioAdditions: Giuseppina was baptized at San Mango d'Aquino on 11 January 1871 as Josephina, daughter of Domenico Gabriele Fiorillo and Saveria Colosimo; the godfather was Felice Sacco. I read the entry on the register photograph (S1, S2). 'Gabriele Fiorillo' was the family's double surname at the time. Her parents had married in the parish on 1 April 1870, so she was their first child (S4). The baptism confirms the tree's 1871 birth year. Her 1920 census age (45) understated it by about four years. The 1943 Pennsylvania death index lists 'Josephine Farino', Scranton, county 35 (Lackawanna), died 4 June 1943, certificate file 54686 (S3). This uses the same 'Farino' spelling as the 1920 census of her household at 1306 Diamond Avenue, so it is very probably her. No 'Ferlaino' entry exists in the same year's index (soundex F645 checked). Her siblings, from the parish index, were Carmelo (1873), Filomena (1874), Carolina (1877), Carmine (1880), Antonio (1884) and Gaetano (1886) (S5).
